summary: Iteration 37 testing complete - Core Decision Engine v2.0. All 25 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend dashboard, AI Models, and Performance pages load correctly. New endpoints /api/signals/decision, /api/signals/engine-status, and /api/signals/record-outcome all working as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: CoreDecisionEngine correctly implements multi-model ensemble voting with configurable weights (IQ-720: 15%, Maximized ML: 30%, Improved ML: 20%, LSTM/GRU: 25%, PPO RL: 10%)
Market regime detection properly identifies 5 regimes: trending_up, trending_down, ranging, high_volatility, low_volatility
Risk management includes 7 risk limits: max_drawdown_pct, max_daily_loss_pct, max_consecutive_losses, min_confidence, max_position_pct, min_win_rate_threshold, cooldown_after_loss_streak_s
Kelly-based position sizing correctly adjusts for confidence, regime, and drawdown
Trade outcome tracking properly updates win_rate, consecutive_losses, max_drawdown_pct, and sharpe_ratio
Decision endpoint correctly returns HOLD when confidence < 65% threshold with LOW_CONFIDENCE warning
seed_data_creation: None - used existing OANDA market data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 37 features tested: 1) GET /api/signals/engine-status returns version 2.0.0, models status (iq720 always trained), model_weights, active_strategies (4 strategies), risk_limits (7 limits), and performance metrics. 2) POST /api/signals/decision generates risk-managed trade decisions with regime detection, model_votes, confidence, position_size_pct, expiry_seconds, stop_loss_pips, take_profit_pips. Returns HOLD when confidence < 65%. 3) POST /api/signals/record-outcome tracks trade results and updates win_rate, consecutive_losses, max_drawdown_pct, sharpe_ratio. 4) Regression tests passed: /api/signals/iq720-ensemble, /api/signals/scan-markets, /api/signal-routing/stats, /api/ml/tuning-report, /api/health. 5) Frontend: Dashboard, AI Models, Performance pages all load correctly.

engine_status_endpoint.notes: Returns version 2.0.0, models (iq720 trained), model_weights (5 models), active_strategies (4 strategies), risk_limits (7 limits), performance metrics

decision_endpoint.notes: Returns action (CALL/PUT/HOLD), confidence, regime, model_votes, position_size_pct, expiry_seconds, stop_loss_pips, take_profit_pips, risk_reward_ratio

record_outcome_endpoint.notes: Accepts symbol, direction, outcome (win/loss), pnl. Updates total_trades, win_rate, consecutive_losses, max_drawdown_pct, sharpe_ratio

hold_on_low_confidence.notes: Decision returns HOLD with LOW_CONFIDENCE warning when confidence < 65%

model_votes.notes: Decision includes model_votes showing which models voted and their directions

signal_routing.notes: Actionable decisions are routed through signal routing service
